B

Day types & meals

One day type = one set of macros + meals (e.g. High carb, Low carb, Rest day). Add several for carb cycling, then map them to weekdays below.

✨

7-day meal variety (Smart)

Generates a Mon–Sun grid of macro-matched meal variations for every meal slot in this plan (one meal per day/slot, like a weekly replacement chart). Uses the client's dietary preference + each meal's macros, then asks your n8n automation to fill it in.

Written in plain English — these rules are sent to the Smart tool as high-priority instructions and can set day-by-day or per-meal conditions.

⚙ Automation settings (n8n webhook)

Tokens: {{diet}} {{cuisine}} {{region}} {{prep}} {{avoid}} {{allergies}} {{notes}} {{meals}} (the meal slots + macro targets). Saved for all clients. Click Save settings to store it.

🍳

Meal prep strategy (Smart)

Generates a batch-cooking / meal-prep strategy for each diet plan (day type) this client has — the ingredients + quantities to buy, a step-by-step prep sequence, and recipe ideas. Uses each day type’s meals + macros and how many days a week the client preps.

⚙ Automation settings (n8n webhook)
The shared secret your n8n passes to the portal callback. Needed for clients to generate directly.
✓ Clients generate their own meal prep automatically — once a webhook URL is saved above, they POST straight to n8n with no coach step. (No toggle needed.)
Clients POST straight to the webhook (same as this panel). Needs CORS = * enabled on the n8n webhook.

Tokens: {{prepDays}} {{notes}} {{plans}}. The JSON output shape is appended automatically. Saved for all clients.

Rewards & S2S Points

Build your points programme: set the money value per point & redeem limit, then add categories and the things clients earn points for. Save stores it. To make it visible to clients, use ⚙ Live sections & retention on the dashboard (for everyone) or a client’s profile → Sections for this client.

Key details

S2S Points awarded automatically when a client submits their weekly check-in (once per week, no approval needed). Set 0 to turn off.
Awarded automatically each time a client logs their body weight — once per day. Set 0 to turn off.
Awarded when a client saves all 3 progress photos (front/side/back) in Progress Tracking → Progress photos — once every 4 weeks. Set 0 to turn off.
Awarded when a client logs a body-composition test — once every 6 weeks. Set 0 to turn off.
Awarded when a client logs their body measurements — once every 6 weeks. Set 0 to turn off.
Points per logged meal (Food Tracking) or food-journal entry, awarded automatically. Set 0 to turn off.
Food Tracking rewards each allocated meal once (5 pts), so a full day of the plan's meals is its natural cap. This number caps the free-form Food Journal (e.g. 15 = 3 entries × 5 pts); the higher of the two counts each day, not both. 0 = no journal cap.
Awarded when a client shares their own recipe (✍️ personal, not ✨ Smart-pulled) with a written step-by-step method, in the Recipes tab. Paid once per recipe (editing it later doesn't re-pay). Set 0 to turn off.
Max number of new personal recipes that earn points each day (e.g. 2 = up to 2 × the points above per day). 0 = no daily cap.

Categories & points

Two sections: ＋ ways clients earn points and − ways they lose points. Add a rule/condition and an optional cap to any category, and use ▲▼ to reorder.

Check-in form builder

These questions appear on every client's weekly check-in, below the standard fields. Reorder by dragging ⠿ (or ▲▼), pick a type per question, then Save draft to keep working, or Publish to make it live. Types: short text · paragraph · number · 1–10 scale · multiple choice.
Branching: use “↳ Show only if” on any question to reveal it only for chosen answers — e.g. tick Poor/OK on a multiple-choice parent, or type 1-4 for a scale — so different responses lead to different follow-up questions.

Add to Home Screen

Save the Transformation Portal to your phone’s home screen so it opens like an app — one tap, full screen, works offline.

On iPhone / iPad (Safari)
  1. Tap the Share icon ⬆️ at the bottom of Safari.
  2. Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
  3. Tap Add — the S2S icon appears on your home screen.

ℹ️ On iPhone/iPad this must be done in Safari — Apple doesn’t let apps or other browsers add to the home screen automatically. If you’re in another browser, open this page in Safari first.

On Android (Chrome)
  1. Tap the ⋮ menu (top-right of Chrome).
  2. Tap Add to Home screen / Install app.
  3. Confirm with Add.
On desktop

Click the install icon in your browser’s address bar (a small ⊕ / screen icon), then confirm. You can also bookmark this page with Ctrl/Cmd + D.

📝 Notes & Scripts

Add a food

🎯 For accurate macros, add ingredients — not whole dishes

A single food (chicken breast, brown rice, paneer)? Just search it below.

A full recipe or dish (chicken curry, protein smoothie)? Logging it as one item is a guess. It’s far more precise to break it into its ingredients and log each with the amount you actually used.

How “Break down a recipe” works: ① our Smart tool splits your recipe into its ingredients → ② each is matched to the closest food in our database → ③ you add any that are missing, then log each with your amounts. Same calories, much more accurate.

⚖️ Cooked vs raw weight matters. Food changes weight when cooked — rice & pasta soak up water (heavier), meat & fish lose it (lighter). Our macros are per the weight on each food (usually raw / dry), so weighing it cooked throws your numbers off. Use ⚖️ Cooked yield to convert.

Tell us the food and how you cook it, and our Smart tool works out the cooking yield — how much its weight changes. Then type either the raw or the cooked weight and we’ll convert it, so you log the right amount against your plan.
